decides_falsified_if: the estimator does not cross-fit, or cross-fitting fails to remove the spurious violation, or the no-cross-fitting arm shows no inflation and the cross-validation therefore has no purpose
decides_verified_if: the folds the released estimator hands the classifier reproduce an independent KFold index for index, are disjoint, cover every row once, and never overlap their own fit set
without cross-fitting, exactly-conditional data reads mean L1-ERT above 0.02 at every size, which is a spurious violation
with five-fold cross-fitting the same data reads |mean L1-ERT| below 0.01 and at least five times smaller
the same holds for k in {2,3,5,10}

quantifiers.construction: oracle quantile sets, whose true ERT is exactly 0

statement: Algorithm 1 estimates the ERT metrics from finite samples using k-fold cross-validation to avoid overfitting the classifier used in the estimation.
would_not_count: reading ert_folds=5 out of a configuration record, which shows the setting and not its effect
